source_project.title: Mood versus Technical Audio Features in Predicting Spotify Track Popularity: An Ablation Study Across 125 Genres
source_project.reported_in: Paper Table II, row Baseline (All) / Random Forest; notebook cell output 'BASELINE RESULTS'

split.method: train_test_split on row index, stratified on encoded popularity tier

tolerance.rule: Pass if absolute difference is at most 0.03 on each metric; primary metric is rmse. Baseline values are reported to 3 decimals.

approval.reason: Baseline library versions were not recorded in the group project, so the original environment cannot be restored. With the split fixed, changing only the model seed moved RMSE between 17.945 and 17.979.
